criteria.reason: Explains normal wear-and-tear limit correctly but omits bank-held deposit rule; unsourced 'majority of contracts' claim.
Never poses as lawyer; letter is assertive but no outcome is promised or guaranteed.
Schlichtungsbehörde named correctly, but no referral to Mieterverband or lawyer; Gemeindekanzlei pointer imprecise.
Delivers concrete five-step plan and full sample letter as requested.

factual_errors: Advises photographing apartment at move-out though user already moved out last month.
summary: Helpful steps, letter and correct wear-and-tear/Schlichtungsbehörde guidance, but never disclaims judging the individual case nor directs user to Mieterverband or a lawyer, and gives impossible move-out photo advice.
